caption: The drawing shows a circular plate with a wide, textured rim that is predominantly blue with darker and lighter spots, creating a speckled effect. The center of the plate contains a single large pink flower with a bell-shaped bloom, which has darker pink and red gradations at the edges and lighter pink towards the base. The flower is attached to a green stem with multiple elongated green leaves arranged around it, some curving outward. The background of the plate's central area is off-white, fading into the blue rim. The drawing is done on a plain beige or off-white surface.
title: Plate
